scope: Phase3 exact episode-wise reachability for unchanged C3/75 and C4/72 on already inspected development data; no new scheduler fitting
known_before_work: All results through the analytic-contribution audit are known, including the original tuning128 sensitivity C3 miss. Generic, legacy and recursive certificate counts on eight cells are known. Recursive counts equal legacy counts there. Earlier exhaustive first-hour offsets do not cover arbitrary later starts.
question: For each fully recorded free episode of duration>=60 seconds, does there exist ANY initial measurement time inside the known window, with the observed run reset on initialization, for which this fixed policy makes no measurement inside the episode?
derivation: All source transition times and deterministic pauses are integer seconds. Initial times k+phi with0<=phi<1 have the same sampled states and observed ages as start k, hence the same whole-episode coverage. A missed long free episode must follow a last free measurement t in[b-G,p), with free observed age on the constant-G plateau. Before that sample the current observed-free run consists of a finite prefix of known pauses followed by G repeats. Search those possible plateau entry times backward and require every prefix/plateau sample to be free. Any successful sequence is itself realizable by initializing at its first free sample. This is a specialized exact coverage test, not generic model checking or a new scheduling algorithm.
independent_validation: Exhaust all integer start times by a separate forward simulator on five alternating intervals with durations1,2,3 and both initial states (486 traces) for three small finite-prefix profiles. Compare the set of individually attainable missed target episodes with the backward method, and compare fractional offsets0.25 and0.75 to each integer start. Also100 seeded eight-interval traces with durations1..8, profiles and both fractional offsets. Include explicit half-open boundary, plateau-prefix and positive-bound-without-attainment cases.
fixed_policy_check: Confirm the reconstructed C3/C4 free prefix and occupied pauses against the frozen48-cell tables before any source replay. Free pauses30 until observed age300,45 until900, then G; occupied30 until300 then60. The plateau is first reached at observed age930, not900. Preserve the earlier abstract A900 bound.
data: Use exactly training256, tuning128, check256 and check512 in both>=7day and>=1day known windows. Load only train_development and validation_development. Compute generic and recursive upper counts, then exact attainable-episode counts for C3 and C4. Recheck each positive witness with the old independent reference simulator through the target episode and one following interval.
reporting: Exact counts refer to episodes each attainable under SOME potentially different initialization. They are not the maximum simultaneous misses from one initialization, nor an event probability under random starts. Zero certifies all starts on the given record under the assumptions. Keep M60 distinct from map F/O and future physical accuracy. Report negative findings, all counters and operation counts; no unfair speedup claim against a narrower replay task.
literature: Relate to previously read primary sampling-invariance and duration-calculus work S14/S16. Targeted searches on missed-event reachability, initial phase and adaptive sampling/model checking; do not treat absence of an exact search hit as originality proof.
decision: Assess whether this exact second stage resolves conservative positive analytical bounds for the fixed policies. Do not promote a candidate, change the original protocol or enter phase4 solely because this verifier works.
